name: Native return to graveyard sends a released ghost back to its graveyard
contract: The ghost frame's Return to graveyard button calls PortGraveyard(), which Extensions.dll sends as the empty CMSG_PORT_GRAVEYARD (0x0544). The frame is shown only to a ghost. Retail's return to graveyard moves a released ghost to its closest graveyard and does nothing for a living or unreleased player. A death in Northshire Valley releases at the Northshire graveyard (graveyard 105, -8935.33 -188.646). Expected: the request reaches the server; a living player is not moved; a ghost walked back to its corpse is returned to the Northshire graveyard.

steps.label: Ask to return to the graveyard while alive
Give a teleport time to start
A living player is not moved
The ghost is released at the Northshire graveyard
The ghost walks back to its corpse
The ghost stands at its corpse, away from the graveyard
Ask to return to the graveyard
The ghost is back at the Northshire graveyard
